morphology.pattern_note: 按姓氏解读，现代马来语中整词记忆，不作派生分析；历史上的父名构成不等于马来语词缀。所列音标为常见英语读法，具体读音以姓名持有者为准。

senses.zh_definition: 亨德里克斯：一个具有荷兰语及北德语来源的姓氏；单凭该姓氏不能确定具体所指人物。
senses.en_definition: Hendricks, a surname of Dutch and North German origin; its bearer must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada tradisi penamaan Belanda dan Jerman Utara; individu yang dimaksudkan bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正常书写为 Hendricks。此处按姓氏释义，原始语境仍可能指同名地点或其他专名。词包未提供 DBP 定义，本条马来文释义为编辑撰写，status 保留为 unverified。排名沿用输入。以下搭配是姓名使用示例，未经频率验证，不指特定真实人物。姓氏来源见[Ancestry 引述的《美国姓氏词典》](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/hendricks)。

etymology.historical_story: Hendricks is a family name rather than a Malay-derived word. The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies it as a Dutch and North German patronymic formed from Hendrick. A patronymic historically indicates descent or family association; modern bearers inherit the surname without its necessarily describing their immediate parent. [Source: dictionary entry reproduced by Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/hendricks).
